description: June birthdays: zodiac signs and decans for every day of June, cusp dates, the month's numerology and its Chinese zodiac boundary.
answer: In Western astrology, June birthdays fall under Gemini and Cancer. In most years June birthdays from the 1st to the 21st are Gemini, and from the 22nd they are Cancer. June 20, June 21 and June 22 are cusp dates. In numerology June is month 6.

sections.heading: Zodiac signs and decans in June
paragraphs: June opens in Gemini's second decan, where Venus as sub-ruler gives the Twins charm and an eye for elegant ideas. Around June 11 the third decan begins, and Uranus lends the sign an inventive, unconventional edge. Around June 21, close to the solstice, the Sun moves into Cancer. That switch, from mutable air to cardinal water, is one of the most noticeable of the year: the mood turns from talk to feeling, from wide social circles to the inner circle. The last days of June sit in Cancer's first decan, where the Moon rules twice over and emotional intuition is strongest. People born in June often carry a mix of lightness and depth, the friend who can chat with anyone and also the one who remembers exactly how you felt.

In most years June birthdays from the 1st to the 21st are Gemini, and from the 22nd they are Cancer. The cusp dates, where the sign can differ by year or time zone, are June 20, 21 and 22; each has its own page explaining both possibilities. Decan by decan, the month opens in the second decan of Gemini, linked with Venus, from the 11th the third decan of Gemini, linked with Uranus and from the 22nd the first decan of Cancer, linked with Moon.

sections.heading: June birthdays in numerology and the Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: June is month 6, the number numerologists associate with nurture, responsibility and harmony in close relationships. It tends to give a birth date a caring, domestic undertone, which fits the Cancerian birthdays at the month's end and quietly grounds the Geminian ones. In the Chinese zodiac, June birthdays follow the calendar year's animal. The Horse month of Four Pillars astrology begins around June 5 or 6 with the solar term Grain in Ear, so the great majority of June birthdays have the Horse in the month pillar. The Horse is traditionally linked with energy, independence and a love of open space, which suits early-summer birthdays in the north. Its freedom-loving streak can sit in lively tension with the home-focused 6, a pairing worth noticing in a full reading.
Every page for a June date lists the Life Path for several birth years, because the year changes the total even when the day stays the same.

sections.heading: Famous June birthdays
paragraphs: Each June page lists the best-known people born on that date, drawn from Wikidata and ranked by how many Wikipedia language editions have an article about them. A sample across the month: Marilyn Monroe (June 1), Lukas Podolski (June 4), Orhan Pamuk (June 7), Judy Garland (June 10), James Clerk Maxwell (June 13), Tupac Shakur (June 16), Aung San Suu Kyi (June 19), Erich Maria Remarque (June 22), George Orwell (June 25) and Jean-Jacques Rousseau (June 28). Sharing a birthday with someone well known says nothing about a life's direction, but it is a pleasant way into the date's sign, decan and numbers, which each page then explains in turn. The lists favour people with a precisely recorded birth date in the modern Gregorian calendar, so some much-celebrated figures from earlier centuries are missing.

faq.question: What is the numerology number of June?
faq.answer: June is month 6. The month is one of three parts of the Life Path calculation, with the day and the year.

faq.question: Which Chinese zodiac animal is someone born in June?
faq.answer: Lunar New Year has always passed by June, so a June birth takes the animal of the calendar birth year.
